rows.title: Text/PDF/Word import: a sub-heading inside a job or school after a blank line becomes a blank entry of its own
rows.summary: Now: a label over a part of the entry above ('Key Responsibilities', 'Highlights', 'Selected Clients', 'Technologies Used', 'Relevant Coursework', 'Activities', 'Promoted to ...'; SUBHEADING in importText.js) is no undated entry: it and its list stay in the job's or school's description. An undated project or freelance job after a dated one is still an entry of its own.

rows.title: Text/PDF/Word import: a job's or school's line ending with several years in brackets is split off as a new blank entry
rows.summary: Now: several years in brackets (bracketDates) date a line only in Certifications and Awards; under a job or a school, 'Named top seller (2019 and 2021)' and 'Dean's List (Fall 2018, Spring 2019)' stay in the entry's description, with no bogus entry and no half-bracket degree or field of study.

rows.title: Text/PDF/Word import (no heading styles): a Title-Case sub-heading inside a job that is also a section name starts a new section and swallows every later job
rows.summary: Now: in an unmarked file, a Title-Case 'Key Achievements'/'Achievements'/'Recognitions' (with a job's date range after it) or a skills title such as 'Tech Stack'/'Tools' (with any dated line after it), inside a section of dated entries and before the next heading, stays that entry's part (partInEntry in importText.js); the later jobs or projects keep their section. A Title-Case Key Achievements or Skills section of its own (followed by a heading, or holding single-year awards) is still a section.
